response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS tradekind FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord r ON a.translink = r.transreg JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg), c AS (SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM j GROUP BY tradekind), s AS (SELECT tradekind, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.tradekind, s.cnt AS count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM s, a WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL AND s.share > a.avg_share

assumptions.assumption: Each advancedbehavior row that links through transactionrecord to a trader counts as one unit of behaviour analysis. Rows with no matching transaction or trader are dropped by the inner joins.
A NULL tradekind is kept as its own group. The average is taken over the per-type shares, including the NULL group, and is not weighted by count.
Shares are unrounded real-number divisions. If there are no groups, the average is NULL and the query returns no rows.
